evidence.note: Only an MCP client in the acceptance tests connects today; no real agent integration is in the code, so this node is inferred.

The read tools list_accounts, list_items, count_items, group_items and list_topics return permitted fields only, for the accounts the token covers, including four semantic fields a quarantined classifier proposes and the gate validates.
Fixture source: a file or the mailbox.org mail stand-in.
The client reaches the service at /mcp over Streamable HTTP with a bearer token the operator issued and can revoke.
